summary: Learn to scope MDM domains, define stewardship and quality rules, and build a practical roadmap. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Master data management coordinates shared core records across business units and systems so teams can define, govern, match, and distribute them. For data stewards, data quality analysts, and MDM program managers, the course offers a practical approach to prioritizing domains, clarifying ownership, and improving records across connected systems. You will build domain inventories and entity models, set matching and survivorship rules, and create quality measures, remediation plans, and a roadmap using sample records and spreadsheet-based artefacts.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who work across business and technology teams to define, steward, integrate, or improve shared entity records. It is designed for people who need a practical foundation in MDM scope, rules, responsibilities, and work products.
prerequisites: No prior MDM platform administration or programming experience is required. Familiarity with business records, spreadsheets, or data-related work is useful. Coding is not required for course completion; SQL, APIs, MDM architecture, and metadata topics receive conceptual or foundation-level treatment. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software for the exercises.
